meta.tagline: Japanese that doesn't feel like homework

landing.heroBody: One continuous learning path, a review system that adapts to you, and practice you'll actually come back to.
landing.featureSrsBody: Every word comes back exactly when you'd otherwise forget it.
landing.featurePathBody: Kana, vocabulary, grammar, kanji — in the order that actually works.
landing.featureFunBody: Earn coins and dress up your character. Learning you can see.

credits.title: Data sources
credits.intro: The learning content in this app comes from open data projects. Their licenses require attribution — here it is, with thanks to everyone who has done this work over decades.
credits.jmdictUse: Vocabulary with German and English meanings, parts of speech and frequency
credits.kanjidicUse: Kanji with readings, stroke counts, school grade and frequency
credits.kanjivgUse: Stroke order for tracing and animation
credits.tatoebaUse: Example sentences with German and English translations
credits.note: Modifications to the data (selection, reshaping, linking) were made for this app and are not the responsibility of the original projects.
